description: Makes a QR code as SVG (styled dots and eyes, any size) or PNG (square modules) from text, a link, Wi-Fi login, e-mail, phone, SMS, contact card, location or calendar event. Fields per type: url: url; text: text; wifi: ssid, password, security, hidden; email: to, subject, body; phone: phone; sms: phone, message; vcard: firstName, lastName, phone, email, company, title, website, street, city, zip, country; location: lat, lng; event: title, start, end, location, description. UTF-8, so diacritics and emoji work.

text.description: Shortcut for type text / the url of type url
